title: Review Quote Card
description: The full-bleed review slide the carousels on every Tour Operator single carry — live's `.lsx-to-widget-item-wrap.lsx-review > article.review`, measured 2026-08-28: the review's photograph as the card's own ground at 500px tall, with a gold quote mark, the headline and the extract centred over it in white and the Read More link in accent-500. Everything here is the type layer only; the crop, the scrim weight and the padding are attributes on the cover in patterns/card-review-quote.php, because a cover serialises them and the editor can then show them. The one colour that is not live's is the scrim itself: live sets white type straight onto the photograph with no overlay, which holds only while every connected review happens to carry a dark image. The neutral-900 overlay is the same one styles/sections/hero-banner.json uses, so the two read as one family.
